Do you have any thoughts about why it didn't go well?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I think part of it is because I haven't been managing my time well. And I've been so distracted since the argument with my parents."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That makes sense. It must be hard to focus with so many things on your mind."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, I've been trying to balance everything, like pleasing my parents and figuring out my future.
